title: New Shores model recipe
description: One kit-bashed model per content ID (ART_DIRECTION §7). Coordinates are in tiles (1 tile = 4 m) in recipe space: Blender axes, z up, origin at the footprint's ground centre, the front edge (the door at rotation 0) toward +y; ships: bow toward +x, origin at the waterline centre. Rotations are XYZ Euler angles in degrees. The footprint is read from content/old_coast, never repeated here. Validated by assets/build/nsassets/schema.py (stdlib subset of JSON Schema: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, pattern, minLength, $ref, oneOf).

id.description: Content ID (content/old_coast/buildings.json or ships.json), decor_<name> for decoration or life_<name> for the life layer.

kind.description: decor: island decoration (trees, bushes, rocks, tufts, stumps, outcrops) with an id starting decor_, not a content ID; listed under the manifest's decor key. life: an element of the life layer (docs/LIFE_LAYER.md: carts, villagers, animals, boats, crates, construction stages) with an id starting life_, drawn with thin instances; listed under the manifest's life key with its anchors; may have variants.

notes.description: What the model shows; production buildings name their signature prop.

shading.description: flat (default): one normal per face; smooth: corner normals averaged over the faces of the same role sharing a position (rounded kit trees and bushes).

ao.description: Baked ambient occlusion: full (default) or crevices (only the strongest levels, shifted down, so small decoration keeps its palette colour and darkens only in its crevices).

parts.description: Parts shared by every variant and level.

variants.description: Variant n (file <id>.v<n>.glb) = parts + variants[n]. Houses have exactly 3.

attachments.description: Separately exported parts drawn on top of the model (<id>.<name>.glb).

budget_exception.description: Doubles the building budget; only trading_post, warehouse, shipyard, chapel and market_small.

wheel_front.description: life carts: pivot of the front axle (wheels spin about x through it).

wheel_rear.description: life carts: pivot of the rear axle.

cart.description: producers and storage buildings: where life carts stop to load (on the ground, inside the footprint).

boat.description: water-edge producers (fisher): the mooring point of the working boat at the jetty, on the water.

berth_1.description: Trading Post: pier slot 1 (one per berth of the top level, berth_1 … berth_4, along the pier front): the stern mooring point; the ship lies bow out to sea from it.

slip.description: shipyard: the slipway's centre line where the hull under construction stands (over the water rows; the hull lies along the slip, bow out to sea).

gate.description: pasture: the gate in the fence.

sheep_1.description: pasture: positions of the three instanced sheep (sheep_1 … sheep_3).

role.description: A colour name of the buildings, terrain, fields or water group of assets/palette.json.

part.description: A kit piece (kit + file, or kit_building), or a procedural primitive (prim + its parameters), placed by position/rotation/scale.

name.description: Label in error messages (default: file or prim and the index).

kit_building.description: A whole kit building by name (KIT_BUILDINGS in assets/build/nsassets/config.py, e.g. home_A, church, lumbermill, windmill, scaffolding) — the kit piece turned so its front faces +y; replaces kit + file and takes the kit-piece options (roles, drop, crop, exaggerate, simplify) and transforms.

file.description: Kit-relative path as listed in assets/kits/MANIFEST.json.

size.description: box: x y z (base centred at z = 0); wedge: ridge length x, depth y, height z; rock: radii x y z.

caps.description: cylinder: draw the top and bottom caps (default: top only).

open.description: box: faces left out (unseen faces cost triangles).

hip.description: wedge: hip inset of both ridge ends (0 = gable roof).

width_top.description: sail: top width (0 = triangle; default = width).

bulge.description: sail: depth of the wind belly toward +y.

profile.description: lathe: (radius, z) points from bottom to top, revolved about z.

bevel.description: Primitives: bevels the sharp edges (> 30°) by this width (tiles, one segment; Blender bevel modifier) — softer, chunkier silhouettes for about 3× the triangles.

rotate.description: Extra rotation about z (degrees) per copy.

repeat.description: Copies the part count times, each moved by step (tiles, recipe space) from the previous.

role.description: Colour of the whole part (required for primitives).

shade.description: Replaces the kit default shade (times the part shade and, for gradient atlases, the band shade).

roles.description: Kit material name (atlas kits: Atlas/<swatch>; gradient atlases also Atlas/<swatch>@<band>, band 0 = light … 2 = dark) → role or {role, shade}; other materials keep the kit default.

drop.description: Kit pieces: materials left out (e.g. Atlas/stone to strip a KayKit plinth; gradient atlases by swatch or swatch@band).

dissolve.description: Planar decimation angle limit (degrees), material borders kept.

collapse.description: Edge-collapse ratio of the remaining triangles.

simplify.description: Mesh simplification of a kit piece (dissolve first, then collapse).

nodes.description: Kit pieces: only these mesh nodes of the file (glTF node names), e.g. a cart body without its axles; an unknown name fails the build.

crop.description: Kit pieces: keeps only the triangles whose centroid lies in this box (kit units, Blender axes, before any transform) — takes a part of a piece.

exaggerate.description: Kit pieces: scales the triangles whose centroid lies in min..max (kit units, Blender axes, before any transform) about pivot (default: the selection's bottom centre), in order — e.g. a roof 1.3× or a chimney 1.5× taller (exaggerated silhouettes).

lod.description: full = only in the full model: left out of the generated lite model. Every building is also exported as <file>.lite.glb (the model without these parts, decimated to ~25 %), drawn by the client at the near-LOD default zoom; the full model is drawn when zoomed in.
